```{r open dataset}
setwd("/Users/dianadanilenko/Desktop/appliances_interventions/")
load("appliances_clean.R")
```

```{r full dataset}
# first, run this without any exlusions
dfinc4 <- appliances # full dataset
# second, check the outputs of summary stats
# third, run on subsets if needed
```

```{r data subsets}
# dfinc <- data_purchase purchase probability
# include WTP and purchase probability together
data_purchase1 <- data.frame()
# filter to a needed dependent variable
data_purchase1 <- appliances %>%
  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category %in% c("purschase (probability) of efficient appliance", "WTP for efficient appliance"))
dfinc5 <- data_purchase1 # purchase probability and WTP

data_usage <- data.frame()
# filter to a needed dependent variable
data_usage <- appliances %>% 
                  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category == "energy use after switching to a more efficient appliance")
dfinc1 <- data_usage # usage

data_marketshare <- data.frame()
# filter to a needed dependent variable
data_marketshare <- appliances %>% 
                  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category == "market share of efficient appliance")
dfinc2 <- data_marketshare # market share

# dfinc3 <- data_wtp wtp

dfinc6 <- dfinc4 %>%
  filter(intervention_category == "Information Strategies")

dfinc7 <- dfinc4 %>%
  filter(intervention_category == "Economic Incentives")

#dfinc8 <- data_purchase3 # excluding outliers
```

```{r}
################DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS##################################
outputPath <- c("/Users/dianadanilenko/Desktop/appliances_interventions/")
short_summ    <- c("appliance",
                   "intervention",
                   "continent",
                   "total_sample_size",
                   "statistical_technique",
                   "study_design",
                   "incentive_follow_through",
                   "experimental_setting",
                   "participant_type",
                   "study_ID"
                   )

sumVarsCatego <- c(
  "aware_of_study",
  "opt_in",
  "randomisation_dummy",
  "outOfSampleBias",
  "reportingBiases",
  "year_publication",
  "year_data_study",
  "controls_energy_prices",
  "controls_environmental_attitudes",
  "controls_demographics")

sumvarsNum <- c("percent_change",
                "z_value",
                "z_variance",
                 "z_value_obs",
                "z_variance_obs")

sumVars <- c(short_summ,sumVarsCatego, sumvarsNum)
```

```{r}
freq(select(dfinc8, all_of(short_summ)), cumul = FALSE)

dfinc8 %>% select(all_of(sumVars)) %>% 
  dfSummary(graph.col = T, style = "grid")  %>% 
  print(file = paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_purchase.html"))
rmarkdown::render(paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_purchase.html"), output_file = paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_purchase.doc"))
```

```{r}
dfinc4[short_summ] <- lapply(dfinc4[short_summ], factor)
dfinc4$total_sample_size <- as.numeric(dfinc4$total_sample_size)
dfinc4[sumVarsCatego] <- lapply(dfinc4[sumVarsCatego], factor)
dfinc4[sumvarsNum] <- lapply(dfinc4[sumvarsNum], as.numeric)


for(col in names(select(dfinc4,all_of(short_summ)))) {
  freq_table <- freq(dfinc4[[col]], style = "rmarkdown", cumul=FALSE)
  print(freq_table)
}

# this line is causing error - and if we skip it the summary output only contains the results for one study_ID = 101
freq(select(dfinc4, all_of(short_summ)), cumul = FALSE)
freq(dfinc4[short_summ[1]], cumul = FALSE)

dfinc4 %>% select(all_of(sumVars)) %>% 
  dfSummary(graph.col = T, style = "grid")  %>% 
  print(file = paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_all.html"))
rmarkdown::render(paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_all.html"), output_file = paste0(outputPath, "summarystatistics_all.doc"))
```
